test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight boys, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are seated around a round table, not necessarily in same order, but with equal spacing between them and all facing the centre of the table. S is seated exactly opposite to P, who has U and R as his immediate neighbours. T is seated immediately next to V, who is to the immediate right of S. Q is exactly opposite to T and does not have R as his immediate neighbour. With this information, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: R is seated exactly opposite to W
S and U are the immediate neighbours of W.
Q and U are not the neighbours of each other.
T is seated immediately next to V but not next to R.

solution:
Given :

 
• Eight boys - P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W
 
• They are seated around a round table but with equal spacing between them
 
• All are facing the center of the table.

​Explanation :

1) S is seated exactly opposite to P, who has U and R as his immediate neighbours. 

As position of U and R with respect to P is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2758dd4d57ebb63e10f6938449959dad6b6fe9b208e411fa42d71b06c38195e6.png] 

 
• Case - (2)​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e622990b240b082e4124922001f12f238cbd32e865356300a0b0fe78ce472df.png] 

2) T is seated immediately next to V, who is to the immediate right of S. 

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/471129961817f2841dc23a4882347b3490ef65abec603777a4a0524173d440bc.png] 

 
• Case - (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7aa3367409e675666509640bece0fdda0e3db2f8a7b59c0e7e7aaa457f0bd66.png] 

3) Q is exactly opposite to T and does not have R as his immediate neighbor.

As in case - (2) there is no possible position for Q, therefore this case is eliminated.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0025baf720ef1d92a2cde58a5d8aea7b19423e6efde21c4ed84587b7ebfa4dca.png] 

**Thus, according to the final arrangement:**

 
• R is seated exactly opposite to W - **Correct**
 
• S and U are the immediate neighbors of W - Incorrect (As S and Q are immediate neighbors of W)
 
• Q and U are not the neighbors of each other - Incorrect (AS Q and U are neighbors of each other)
 
• T is seated immediately next to V but not next to R - Incorrect ( As T is seated immediate next to both V and R)

Hence, **"****R is seated exactly opposite to W"** is the correct answer.
